_comment: Opochtli Landing Port Authority vuln-planting side. Every catalog config referenced here is GENERIC and var-driven (see boxbuilder/vulndb_vuln_configs/) except the two box-agnostic network artifacts -- raw-socket-beacon (compiled binary embedded as base64; source + patch provenance in raw-socket-beacon.c) and backdoor-firewall-rule -- both reusable by any future firewall-themed box. Each FILE_PATH / SERVICE_NAME / USERNAME here MUST match its paired check's collect.path / service / pattern in scenario.yaml exactly -- nothing cross-checks them. The docking-agent python payload (PAYLOAD_PATH /usr/local/libexec/docking-agent) is scored by a process_state regex on the cmdline and binds 0.0.0.0:31337, so its path must stay in sync with scenario.yaml's docking_agent_killed pattern and beacon_port_quiet script. The raw-socket-beacon installs /usr/local/libexec/.cache-refresh (BEACON_PATH default) scored by beacon_killed's pattern -- if you override BEACON_PATH there, update that pattern. cache-prune.service and docking-agent.service are scored by service_state disabled checks, so both plants must be ENABLED (their seeds default to enabled). The beacon deliberately listens on NO port: finding it is a process-review exercise. backdoor-firewall-rule's SOURCE_IP (198.51.100.77, RFC 5737 TEST-NET-2 -- unroutable by design) must match the backdoor_rule_removed script and fq-backdoor-source answer; the beacon's baked C2 (203.0.113.66:8443, TEST-NET-3) must match fq-c2-destination. The planted authorized_keys line carries the harbor-pilot-key comment scored by no_planted_pilot_key and fq-key-comment. harbormaster and its .ssh dir are created during TEMPLATE PREP (before plant), not by a catalog config. Run `nakon catalog check --config nakon.json --json` after the bundled seeds have been ensured in vulndb.

vars.FILE_CONTENT:
OPOCHTLI LANDING -- MASTER CARGO MANIFEST (RESTRICTED)
Berth 7: MV Coyolxauhqui -- cocoa concentrate, consignee Cocoa Falls Chocolate Works
Berth 9: MV Ridge Runner -- telescope optics, consignee Coyolxauhqui Ridge Solar Observatory
Berth 12: MV Halcyon Tide -- mixed general cargo
Duty pilot rotation and tug schedules on file with the harbormaster.
DO NOT SHARE outside the pilot office.

-----BEGIN TRAINING PRIVATE KEY-----
not-a-real-key
-----END TRAINING PRIVATE KEY-----

vars.PAYLOAD_BODY:
import socket, time
srv = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
srv.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
srv.bind(("0.0.0.0", 31337))
srv.listen(5)
while True:
    try:
        conn, _addr = srv.accept()
        conn.sendall(b"docking-ok\n")
        conn.close()
    except Exception:
        time.sleep(5)
